events.what: Bolbachan proves Goncharov's conjecture in next to Milnor degree (degree m-1, weight m) for fields of characteristic zero, rationally

judgement.doubts: One fixed degree/weight offset of a general conjecture is a case, so partial holds; the competing 'open' reading would treat a case as no change, which §4 does not. The 2025-10-17 v2 is a revision and does not re-date the event. Two adjacent 2026 papers (arXiv:2606.23863, arXiv:2604.17671) were not read by the researcher; they are unlikely to exceed a case but were not checked.
